Definition: Daily mean temperature; per 1 °C; distributed lag 0–7 unless otherwise labelled
Interpretation: Cumulative RR is the exponentiated sum of separate lag coefficients

Definition: Daily concentration; per 10 µg/m³; lag 0–7 in specified models
Interpretation: Not included in the source-expanded Mexican broad/strict state calendar models

Definition: Heat > area-specific P90; smoke > area-specific P75; reference group neither; Brazil thresholds use 2008–2020 and Mexico 2018–2020
Interpretation: Heat-only, smoke-only, and compound contrasts are same-day categorical comparisons, not per-unit effects

Definition: 49 Brazilian dates and 38 Mexican dates in 2018–2022: recurring public dates plus national federal-election dates
Interpretation: Does not capture every local holiday, optional day, local election, or hospital schedule

Definition: Pooled area-day cut points: Brazil 2008–2023; Mexico 2018–2022; Q1 reference
Interpretation: Quintiles are not cut locally. Q5-versus-Q1 RRs were 1.094 (1.075–1.114) in Brazil and 1.142 (1.047–1.247) in Mexico; Mexico Q4 was 1.144 (1.056–1.238), so the pattern is not monotonic

Definition: NASA POWER state-capital temperature and fire-related PM₂.₅, jointly modeled on the same day; 43,671 rows
Interpretation: Temperature RR 1.0165 (1.0091–1.0240) per 1 °C; fire-PM₂.₅ RR 0.874 (0.814–0.939) per 10 µg/m³. The below-one fire estimate is not interpreted as protective

Definition: Broad N20–N23; same-day NASA POWER temperature at state-capital coordinates and municipality fire PM₂.₅
Interpretation: This is not a lag 0–7 model; municipality refers to the matching stratum and the temperature remains a state-capital point assignment
